raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Starting with batch 12 (and possibly others), the source delivers raw_transactions.amount with a leading '$' (e.g. '$75.13'), which breaks CAST to DECIMAL. The values are plain USD dollars on the same scale as the other batches (currency is always USD, max is 99.91), so stripping the '$' recovers the correct amounts.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(trim(amount), '$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
